# equin-site

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: The equin site's page actions in the browser extension: on equin.ai, 'Open locally' (the same page on the local instance — the site's paths are the website app's, so it is an origin swap); on any local equin page, 'Open on equin.ai' (a website page at the same path, any other page at the site's home). The mapping is the website's own (apps/website/shell core); this leaf only offers it, so the website's composition never carries the extension.
- Web:
  - Contributes:
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin (local): Open on equin.ai"
    - `BrowserExtension.PageAction` "equin.ai: Open locally"
  - Uses: `companions/browser-extension.BrowserExtension`

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:END -->
